summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology with hands-on experience across the full AI/ML project lifecycle — data pipeline design, model training, evaluation, and production integration. Built and deployed models for computer vision, speech recognition, and document understanding using PyTorch, TensorFlow, and Hugging Face Transformers.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT (OCR-free visual document understanding transformer) on a custom dataset for text extraction using PyTorch; improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93%.
Built preprocessing and training pipelines to standardize evaluation workflows aligned with production requirements.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Trained and evaluated YOLOv8 models on Google Colab, improving classification accuracy from 78% to 97.5%; model deployed in a consumer mobile app.
Curated and annotated a custom toothbrush detection dataset for health-level classification.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Architected a full metal surface inspection AI pipeline (custom image stitching, wavelet denoising, monocular depth estimation); achieved PSNR of 86 and ±8% error on 3D crack profiling.
Deployed ZoeDepth for production surface reconstruction; designed concurrent processing to meet real-time throughput requirements.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Trained U-Net segmentation with VGG-16, VGG-19, and ResNet-50 backbones on BraTS 2020 MRI dataset; evaluated on Dice Score and IoU with accuracy-latency trade-off analysis.
Led a cross-cultural team of 7 as sole ML-experienced member; restructured task distribution to deliver full pipeline within 6-week window.

projects.name: COFFIN – Whisper-Style ASR from Scratch
bullets: Built an end-to-end ASR pipeline in PyTorch: 80-channel mel spectrogram encoder, 6-block causal Transformer decoder with cross-attention; achieved training loss ~0.51 and 15% WER on Hindi-English evaluation.
Designed a Cython-accelerated BPE tokenizer achieving 4–5.5× speedup over pure Python, processing 6M characters in 15 minutes.

projects.name: GPT-2 Style Language Model from Scratch
bullets: Implemented a GPT-2 style Transformer in PyTorch — multi-head self-attention, MLP blocks, residual connections, weight tying — with a custom TikToken training loop and perplexity evaluation.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced TinyLlama 1.1B memory footprint by ~25% via structured pruning and 8-bit quantization; benchmarked across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC.
Evaluated accuracy-efficiency trade-offs: ~7% accuracy drop and +6.3 perplexity increase under full compression.

awards: 1st Prize, Poster Presentation — 2D and 3D Image Mosaicing of Microscopic Images, F.C.R.I.T. (2024)
Ranked 10th, Robocon — National-level robotics competition among 45 universities (2022)
